findings.title: `AssignmentSource.queued` default value is evaluated once at import time
findings.body: In `AssignmentSource`, `queued: datetime = timezone.now()` evaluates `timezone.now()` once when the module is imported rather than when each `AssignmentSource` instance is created. Every instance that relies on the default will share the same stale timestamp. Use `dataclasses.field(default_factory=timezone.now)` instead.

findings.title: `assignment_source` added to `sync_status_outbound` instead of `sync_assignee_outbound`, and passed to implementations that may not accept it
findings.body: `IssueSyncIntegration.sync_status_outbound` was updated to take `assignment_source: AssignmentSource | None = None`, even though status syncing does not pass `assignment_source`. Meanwhile, `src/sentry/integrations/tasks/sync_assignee_outbound.py` (line 60) passes `assignment_source=parsed_assignment_source` to `installation.sync_assignee_outbound(...)`. Any integration subclass whose `sync_assignee_outbound` signature does not accept `assignment_source` or `**kwargs` will fail at runtime with `TypeError: got an unexpected keyword argument 'assignment_source'`. Either remove `assignment_source` from the `installation.sync_assignee_outbound(...)` call (since `should_sync` already consumes it) or update `sync_assignee_outbound` on `IssueSyncIntegration` and all concrete integration implementations to accept it.
